study: Independent English BANKING77 intent classification prototype for financial support triage

word_char.vectorizer: FeatureUnion(word, char_wb) using the specified vectorizers

fit_policy: Fit each model on the stratified training split only; do not refit on full official training data.
selective_policy: Use top-1 minus top-2 decision score margin. For each model select the threshold with maximum validation coverage subject to at least 100 accepted validation examples and accepted validation error rate <= 0.05; ties choose the larger threshold. Freeze before opening official test.csv.
synthetic_typo: For each official test text, locate the first word containing at least five ASCII letters and swap its two middle adjacent letters; leave text unchanged if no such word exists. This is deterministic synthetic perturbation, not real user noise.

latency.measure: per-example vectorization plus classification wall time after one warmup example

reporting: Record environment, training times, data hashes, split-index hash, protocol hash, validation and test metrics. predictions.csv stores row index, gold/predicted labels, margin, and accept flag only; never raw text.
limitations: This is an independent English financial support triage prototype, not a result for an existing ResolveAI system.
No real LLM/API calls or costs are involved.
Synthetic typo results do not estimate performance on naturally occurring noisy text.
